# Brock at 0 badges (BattleType 3): running from a trainer is refused, then
# Bulbasaur L20's Razor Leaf is super effective against Geodude (Rock/Ground,
# x4). The win pays XP and money, and "End Fight" gives the BoulderBadge and
# unlocks Misty.
Money 1000
party 1 20
> start
> seed 2
> menu Actions > Fight a Trainer > Kanto Gym Leaders > Brock
log Brock wants to fight!
log Brock sent out Geodude!
dialog information "Select a POKéMON from the Statistics Window. You'll be asked to confirm your choice." -> OK
> answer yes
> choose 1
dialog information "# 001 Bulbasaur, L.20, XP:8000, XP to next level:1261" -> OK
dialog confirmation "Choose Bulbasaur?" -> Yes
log Bulbasaur, I choose you!
> run
log No! There's no running from a trainer battle!
> fight 4
rand 10 = 0
rand 20 = 13
log Bulbasaur used Razor Leaf!
log It's super effective!
log Bulbasaur did 124 points of damage to enemy Geodude.
log Enemy Geodude fainted!
log Bulbasaur gained 397 experience points!
rand 3 = 1
log You got 500¥!
> state

> end
